4405: def mining_success_probability(
4406:     n_missions: int,
4407:     p_first:    float,
4408:     alpha:      float,
4409:     p_mature:   float,
4410: ) -> float:
4411:     """Fleet-average probability the mining chain works, over `n_missions`.
4412: 
4413:     Reliability grows with flight heritage: failure modes get found and
4414:     designed out.  The Duane / AMSAA model has failure probability fall as a
4415:     power law in cumulative production,
4416: 
4417:         q(n) = q_first · n^(−α),    p(n) = 1 − q(n)
4418: 
4419:     capped at `p_mature`, because growth is asymptotic; no amount of heritage
4420:     makes a machine that grinds rock in vacuum certain to work.
4421: 
4422:     Returns the MEAN over missions 1..N, not the terminal value.  That is the
4423:     figure the rest of the cost model needs: NRE and the rig are amortised
4424:     across the whole programme, so the per-mission expected revenue has to be
4425:     the programme average.  Quoting the last mission's reliability would
4426:     credit every mission with heritage that only the last one has.
4427: 
4428:     Exactly `p_first` at N = 1, so a single-mission run is unaffected.
4429:     """
4430:     n = max(1, int(n_missions))
4431:     q_first = max(0.0, 1.0 - p_first)
4432:     q_floor = max(0.0, 1.0 - p_mature)
4433:     total = 0.0
4434:     for k in range(1, n + 1):
4435:         q = q_first * (k ** -alpha) if alpha > 0 else q_first
4436:         total += 1.0 - max(q, q_floor)
4437:     return total / n

value: {"category":"Expendable upper stage recurring cost","unit":"USD per kg of stage dry mass","value":4800.0,"range_low":1750.0,"range_high":13400.0,"notes":"v1.16.0.  The whole stage — tanks, engine, avionics — not the tank alone, which is the row below.  Read by spacecost.delivery, whose chains expend a stage on every burn and until v1.16.0 charged it only for being LAUNCHED, never for being built.\nLow: Falcon 9's upper stage, ~$10M to build (Musk 2018) or ~$7M (2026 third-party estimate) on ~4,000 kg dry, $1,750-2,500/kg: the cheapest flying upper stage, because it is mass-produced, but kerolox.  High: Centaur III, ~$30M (the same figure the tank row below derives from) on ~2,250 kg dry = ~$13,400/kg: the hydrolox stage whose Isp the delivery chains actually fly, but built at a low rate.  Neither is the stage the chain describes, so the value is the geometric centre of the two, $4,840, rounded to $4,800 — the same rule the launch table uses for its own bands.\nSourcing, anchor by anchor: '~$10M (Musk 2018)' is a public statement with no document behind it; the '~$7M (2026 third-party estimate)' names no source; and Centaur III's ~$30M is an unsourced vendor-class estimate.  NASA's Centaur history (Dawson & Bowles, Taming Liquid Hydrogen, NASA SP-2004-4230, 2004) gives programme costs only (the original contract's '$36 million for six vehicles'; an $80M Shuttle/Centaur appropriation against 1981 funding of $20M) and no production cost per stage.  No institutional document prices either anchor.","reference_year":2026}

value: {"category":"Propellant tank recurring cost","unit":"USD per kg of tank dry mass","value":6000.0,"range_low":3000.0,"range_high":25000.0,"notes":"v1.10.0.  Module 3 has derived tank MASS per propellant since v1.9.0 (tank_kg_per_L) and Module 4 has flown it through the rocket equation since then — but nothing ever priced it, so the tank paid its launch $/kg and cost nothing to build.  That is the same mass-without-a-price asymmetry as the free electric-propulsion stage, just smaller.\nDerived from Centaur III, the closest flight article: ~1,880 kg of stage structure, ~$30M for the stage against ~$20M for the RL10 it carries, so ~$10M of structure ≈ $5,300/kg (the ~$30M has no institutional source; see 'Expendable upper stage recurring cost').  Rounded up to $6,000 and quoted as a LOWER BOUND, consistent with the rest of this table: Centaur is a mature production article and a deep-space tank holding propellant for four years needs insulation Centaur does not carry.  The upper end of the range is where a one-off, long-duration cryogenic tank plausibly lands.\nIt is deliberately the CHEAPEST hardware rate here — below the $60k/kg passive berthing adapter — because a tank is the simplest article in the mission: no mechanisms, no docking interface, no re-entry.  Do not read its small effect as a reason to drop it; the point of the line is that every kilogram in the mass cascade has one.","reference_year":2026}

"""R351 cold-start parallel-cohort reliability-growth audit; scratch in GR.

The cold-start scenario has no additional preflight maturation or in-cohort
corrective changes. Serial controls are outside this scenario, not certified
timing models. No source probability, growth coefficient, cost or mass rate is
re-pinned. Every selected programme tuple exists in the original ladder.
"""
import ast
import contextlib
import copy
import hashlib
import io
import json
import math
import platform
import sys
import types
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
PINS={'economicspace':'54e30b0ae82be71c987f08feb95630502b7f54f0',
      'spacecost':'860bef9902aa67fec705875cd52fdb8e6def159f',
      'spacevalue':'873b91c1ce51fd2f5fe9ead63ce171d755e73011',
      'AsteroidCatalog':'66fb47aaeb17aa7e11c023773a39765c1aa793fb'}
sys.path[:0]=[str(ROOT.parent/'spacecost'),str(ROOT.parent/'spacevalue')]
calc=types.ModuleType('r351_original_calc');sys.modules[calc.__name__]=calc
calc._runtime=types.SimpleNamespace(DEFAULT_OUTPUT_DIR=str(ROOT/'.r351_unused'))
src=ROOT.parent/'economicspace/modules/calc.py'
tree=ast.parse(src.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
nodes=[n for n in tree.body if isinstance(n,(ast.Import,ast.ImportFrom,ast.Assign,
    ast.AnnAssign,ast.ClassDef,ast.FunctionDef,ast.Assert))]
with contextlib.redirect_stdout(io.StringIO()):
    exec(compile(ast.Module(body=nodes,type_ignores=[]),str(src),'exec'),calc.__dict__)
    import spacecost as sc
    from spacecost.prices import merge_propellant_prices
    import spacevalue.catalog as sv
    svcfg=sv.MineralValueConfig(output_dir=str(ROOT/'.r351_catalog'),
        delivery_destination='cislunar',use_yfinance=False,use_metals_api=False)
    mineral=sv.build_mineral_value_catalog(svcfg)
    vehicles=sc.load_launch_vehicles()
    props=merge_propellant_prices(sc.load_propellants(),pd.DataFrame())
    ops=sc.load_operational_costs()
assert len(mineral)==59 and 'annual_market_kg' in mineral
ORIGINAL_LADDER=calc._programme_ladder_cached
ORIGINAL_GROWTH=calc._mining_reliability_cached


def clean(x):
    if isinstance(x,dict):return {str(k):clean(v) for k,v in x.items()}
    if isinstance(x,(list,tuple)):return [clean(v) for v in x]
    if isinstance(x,np.generic):return clean(x.item())
    if isinstance(x,float) and not math.isfinite(x):return None
    return x


def typed(x):
    t=type(x).__module__+'.'+type(x).__qualname__
    if isinstance(x,dict):return [t,[[k,typed(v)] for k,v in sorted(x.items())]]
    if isinstance(x,(list,tuple)):return [t,[typed(v) for v in x]]
    if isinstance(x,(float,np.floating)):return [t,float(x).hex()]
    if isinstance(x,np.generic):return [t,repr(x.item())]
    return [t,repr(x)]


def digest(x):
    return hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(typed(x),ensure_ascii=False,separators=(',',':')).encode()).hexdigest()


def run(f,diagnostic):
    n=int(f['n']);fleet=int(f.get('fleet',n));waves=n//fleet
    assert n==fleet*waves
    mineral_name=f.get('mineral','magnetite')
    row=dict(designation='R351 '+f['id'],name=f['id'],diameter_km=1.,density_gcm3=3.,
        estimated_mass_kg=3e12*math.pi/6,semi_major_axis_au=f.get('a',1.2),eccentricity=0.,
        inclination_deg=0.,rotation_period_h=10.,comp_ice_fraction=0.,comp_carbon_fraction=0.,
        comp_metal_fraction=(1. if mineral_name=='nickel-iron' else 0.),
        comp_silicate_fraction=(0. if mineral_name=='nickel-iron' else 1.),
        comp_pgm_enrichment=1.,comp_phases=json.dumps({mineral_name:1.}))
    cfg=calc.CalcConfig(delivery_destination='cislunar',use_beneficiation=False,
        market_model='capacity_cap',optimise_programme_scale=True,model_refinery=False,
        model_launch_windows=False,use_isru_return_propellant=False,
        model_reliability=f.get('risk',True),model_reliability_growth=f.get('growth',True),
        max_fleet_ships=n,nre_amortization_missions=1,apply_wacc_compounding=False)
    m=mineral.copy(deep=True);m.attrs={}
    o=ops.copy(deep=True);o.attrs={}
    v=copy.deepcopy(vehicles.loc[vehicles['name']==f.get('vehicle','Falcon 9 (reusable)')].iloc[0].to_dict())
    p=copy.deepcopy(props.loc[props['name']=='kerolox  (RP-1 / LOX)'].iloc[0].to_dict())
    ladder_events=[];growth_events=[]

    def restrict_ladder(rig_trips,config,market_mode=None):
        choices,original_fleet=ORIGINAL_LADDER(rig_trips,config,market_mode)
        chosen=(n,fleet,waves)
        assert chosen in choices,(f['id'],chosen,rig_trips,choices)
        ladder_events.append(dict(chosen=chosen,original_choices=len(choices),
            original_contains_chosen=True,rig_trips=rig_trips))
        return [chosen],[fleet]

    def cold_start_growth(count,p_first,alpha,p_mature):
        native=ORIGINAL_GROWTH(count,p_first,alpha,p_mature)
        assert count==n
        # Only the declared parallel first-wave/no-added-maturation scenario.
        # No claim that arbitrary sequential programmes should be held flat.
        used=(ORIGINAL_GROWTH(1,p_first,alpha,p_mature)
            if diagnostic and waves==1 and fleet>1 else native)
        growth_events.append(dict(n=count,fleet=fleet,waves=waves,p_first=p_first,
            alpha=alpha,p_mature=p_mature,native_average=native,used_average=used))
        return used

    calc._programme_ladder_cached=restrict_ladder
    calc._mining_reliability_cached=cold_start_growth
    try:
        result=calc.evaluate_asteroid(row,{'minerals':m,'ops':o},cfg,combos=[(v,p)])
    finally:
        calc._programme_ladder_cached=ORIGINAL_LADDER
        calc._mining_reliability_cached=ORIGINAL_GROWTH
    assert result is not None,f['id']
    assert result['m_launch_kg']<=v['payload_leo_kg']*(1+1e-8)
    assert result['feed_processed_kg']<=result['throughput_cap_kg']*(1+1e-9)
    assert n*(result['feed_processed_kg']+result['isru_feed_kg'])<=row['estimated_mass_kg']*(1+1e-9)
    assert result['mission_duration_yr']<=cfg.max_mission_duration_yr*(1+1e-9)
    assert result['mining_duration_yr']<=cfg.max_mining_duration_yr*(1+1e-9)
    assert result['return_volume_m3']<=.25*v['fairing_volume_m3']*(1+1e-9)
    if waves==1:
        assert math.isclose(result['programme_span_yr'],result['mission_duration_yr'],rel_tol=1e-12)
    if f.get('risk',True) and f.get('growth',True):
        assert growth_events
        event=growth_events[0]
        independent=math.fsum(min(event['p_mature'],1-(1-event['p_first'])*k**(-event['alpha']))
            for k in range(1,n+1))/n
        assert math.isclose(independent,event['native_average'],rel_tol=2e-15)
    return result,row,ladder_events,growth_events


CASES=[dict(id='parallel_2',n=2),dict(id='parallel_5',n=5),dict(id='parallel_10',n=10),
    dict(id='parallel_25',n=25),dict(id='parallel_50',n=50),dict(id='parallel_100',n=100),
    dict(id='parallel_25_inner',n=25,a=1.1),dict(id='parallel_25_outer',n=25,a=1.3,vehicle='Falcon Heavy (expendable)'),
    dict(id='parallel_10_heavy',n=10,vehicle='Falcon Heavy (expendable)'),
    dict(id='parallel_25_metal',n=25,mineral='nickel-iron'),
    dict(id='one_mission_control',n=1),dict(id='risk_off_25_control',n=25,risk=False),
    dict(id='growth_off_25_control',n=25,growth=False),
    dict(id='serial_2_outside_scope_control',n=2,fleet=1),
    dict(id='serial_5_outside_scope_control',n=5,fleet=1),
    dict(id='growth_off_100_control',n=100,growth=False),
    dict(id='risk_off_2_control',n=2,risk=False),dict(id='risk_off_100_control',n=100,risk=False),
    dict(id='serial_3_outside_scope_control',n=3,fleet=1),
    dict(id='serial_4_outside_scope_control',n=4,fleet=1),
    dict(id='one_mission_risk_off_control',n=1,risk=False)]
records=[]
for fixture in CASES:
    native,row,ladder,events=run(fixture,False)
